$description: Gesture interaction tokens. Defines thresholds and timings for touch and pointer gestures per Material Design 3 and platform conventions.

gesture.$description: Gesture detection thresholds and response timings

long-press.$description: Time before long-press triggers. Android/M3 standard.

double-tap-window.$description: Maximum time between taps for double-tap detection.

tap-timeout.$description: Minimum time to distinguish tap from scroll initiation.

hold-delay.$description: Delay before continuous action starts (e.g., number stepper hold).

debounce.$description: Debounce interval for rapid gesture events.

touch-slop.$description: Minimum movement to initiate drag (cancels tap). Android touch slop.

swipe-threshold.$description: Minimum distance for swipe gesture recognition.

fling-min-distance.$description: Minimum distance for fling gesture with velocity.

fling-max.$description: Maximum velocity (px/s) cap for fling animations.

dismiss-velocity.$description: Velocity (px/s) that triggers dismissal regardless of distance.

scroll-velocity-threshold.$description: Velocity (px/s) that distinguishes scroll from tap.

deceleration.$description: Momentum deceleration factors for fling animations

threshold.$description: 50% threshold - snap to nearest if past halfway.

velocity-override.$description: Velocity (px/s) that overrides threshold (snaps in direction of motion).

min-scale-delta.$description: Minimum scale change to register pinch gesture.

min-pointers.$description: Minimum touch points for pinch gesture.

min-angle.$description: Minimum rotation angle to register gesture.

min-pointers.$description: Minimum touch points for rotation gesture.
